mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS tenant_id, t.slug AS tenant_slug, t.name AS tenant_name, m.role FROM membership m JOIN tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, t.status AS tenant_status FROM membership m JOIN tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND (m.status <> 'ACTIVE' OR t.status <> 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY t.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM membership m JOIN tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT m.user_id, m.role, m.status FROM membership m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership (user_id, tenant_id, role, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tenantId}, 'MEMBER', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE membership SET status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM membership WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
